text:
```yaml
name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y bats jq curl

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          make docker-build

      - name: Start test cluster
        run: |
          make e2e-up

      - name: Run E2E suite
        id: e2e
        run: |
          timeout 120 make e2e || true

      - name: Collect container logs on failure
        if: failure() && steps.e2e.outcome == 'failure'
        run: |
          make e2e-logs

      - name: Cleanup resources
        if: always()
        run: |
          make e2e-down
```
